questions.stem: What helps blood in veins to keep flowing back towards the heart despite low blood pressure?

options.text: Thick muscular walls that contract rhythmically
Valves that prevent backflow and skeletal muscle contractions
Elastic fibres that recoil after each heartbeat
High concentrations of haemoglobin in the blood

questions.explanation: Veins contain valves that prevent blood from flowing backwards, and the squeezing action of surrounding skeletal muscles helps push blood back towards the heart.
